warnings: push writes the infobase '/workspace/ib-c' of another working copy: it is held by the working copy '/workspace/C' on this machine. The command changes that working copy's infobase, and its owner stays as it is in the owner marker '/workspace/.ib-c.v8-runner.owners.json'. To free the infobase: remove the infobase from v8project.local.yaml of '/workspace/C' or remove that working copy. Ways to an infobase of this working copy's own (`init --infobase` keeps the previous section as upstream): its own clean infobase built from the sources — `v8-runner init --infobase <connection string>`, then `v8-runner infobase create`; a copy of an infobase with its data — `v8-runner init --infobase <connection string>`, then `v8-runner infobase create --from upstream`; an infobase deployed from a reference image — `v8-runner init --infobase <connection string>`, then `v8-runner infobase restore --input <reference>.dt --create`

error.message: cannot push: this working copy has no memory of file infobase '/workspace/ib-c' with no configured infobase user for source-set 'main', so nothing proves that the sources derive from its state; an empty infobase is not told apart, because its generation depends on the platform version. If the infobase holds the right state, see what is there with `v8-runner --config /workspace/D/v8project.yaml pull main`; if the source directory does, run `v8-runner --config /workspace/D/v8project.yaml push --force`, which loads the whole directory and replaces the configuration in the infobase, losing what was changed there.
